info.title: M3 property maintenance
info.description: M3 reporting, scoped dispatch, repair and independent acceptance over existing M1 resource HTTP v1; one-time evaluation, durable stage escalation and scoped basic statistics. M3-owned inbox/read isolation and bounded leased SMTP delivery are implemented for explicit local development adapters. Resource operations persist before HTTP and confirmed receipts gate business state. Shared identity/catalog policy, audit/outbox/runner integration, production verified mail, INT-04 and team/manual acceptance remain pending; local SMTP acceptance is not production delivery.

post.description: Current authority is checked before historical command replay. Durable operation, workorder, command, audit and outbox commit together; actual M1 HTTP runs after this transaction. Terminal release failure requires coordination and keeps safety.

Action.description: ASSIGN requires assigneeId and a nonblank comment. FINISH and REJECT_ACCEPTANCE require a nonblank comment. Other actions omit assigneeId. First execution checks expectedVersion; replay reuses identical input/key and current authority. START/APPROVE_ACCEPTANCE queue resource operations; RETRY_RESOURCE resumes a PAUSED unknown operation with its original operation ID. EVALUATE requires score (integer 1..5), optional comment <=500 characters, completed owner-only order within its saved evaluation window. Other actions do not accept a score value. Same-key committed rating replays even after expiry; it never changes resources.

Statistics.description: Created-at cohort within current authorized areas; cancelled separate/excluded. First-event timings use available samples; repair/acceptance only completed orders. Rating denominator excludes unrated. Recorded overdue rate counts persisted escalation history divided by noncancelled orders; unresolved resources separate. Acceptance time excludes resource synchronization after approval request.
